NP Presspad 1.2.5 — Accurate "Last Modified" dates in WordPress

A companion plugin fix for the posts list in WordPress. **This one needs a companion plugin update** — WordPress will offer it under Plugins after you update the app.

## WordPress posts list

- The "Last Modified" column now shows when a draft was actually last edited. WordPress labels that column "Last Modified" for anything unpublished, but has always displayed the date the post was *created* — so an edited draft kept showing its original date no matter how many times it was revised, whether the edit came from this app or from WordPress itself.
- Published and scheduled posts are unaffected: the date shown there is genuinely the publish date, and it stays that way.

Nothing is rewritten on your site to achieve this — the modified date was already recorded correctly, and only the display was wrong.
